mandate: C337 — test the cross-sectional intraday ORDER-FLOW SKEW / ASYMMETRIC IMPULSE SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (7776 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: imb=signed_volume/total_volume (total_volume<=0 -> NaN); buy_impulse=max(signed_volume,0); sell_impulse=abs(min(signed_volume,0)); asym=(buy_impulse-sell_impulse)/(buy_impulse+sell_impulse) (denom<=0 -> NaN). skew_t=sample skewness of imb over trailing lookback L bars (full-window finite, std>0 else NaN); skew_ewm_t=EWMA(skew_t,halflife=24 bars); asym_ewm_t=EWMA(asym_t,halflife=24 bars). Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), min_periods=3, NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: skew_dev/asym_dev/skew_ewm_dev/asym_ewm_dev = seasonal dislocation -(v-m)/sd; skew_z/asym_z = level z +(v-m)/sd; skew_placebo/asym_placebo = seasonal dislocation of recorded-seed phase-randomized surrogates (attribution placebos, never edges). Seasonal window {expanding,trailing_90d,trailing_180d}. Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: total_volume<=0 -> imb NaN; denom<=0 -> asym NaN; skew NaN unless full lookback window finite and std>0; skew_ewm NaN until >= 24 finite obs (no ffill/impute); same-bucket seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0; raw flow fields carry zero NaN except zero-activity denominators.

data_quality.note: skew NaN share dominated by full-window finite requirement plus rare zero-activity bars; zero-activity bars add negligible mass.

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; signed_volume/total_volume real from C312.
methodology.primitives: imb=signed_volume/total_volume (tv<=0 -> NaN); buy_impulse=max(signed_volume,0); sell_impulse=abs(min(signed_volume,0)); asym=(buy-sell)/(buy+sell) (denom<=0 -> NaN).
methodology.signals: skew_t=sample skew of imb over trailing L bars; skew_ewm_t=EWMA(skew_t,24 bars); asym_ewm_t=EWMA(asym_t,24 bars); score=sign*(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 7776 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
